column5: 'A Phase 2, Open-Label, Single-Center, Long-Term Immunogenicity Follow-Up Study of the GVGH altSonflex1-2-3 Shigella Vaccine 1, 2 and 3 Years After Vaccination in African Children', 179 participants. Every intervention reads 'No intervention is administered in this extension study': the vaccine was given in the parent studies H06_01TP (212149) and H06_02TP (219449), and the primary outcomes are serotype-specific anti-LPS IgG at 12, 24 and 36 months after the last parent-study dose; primary completion 2028-10-16 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07320716, read 2026-11-16). GVGH is the GSK Vaccines Institute for Global Health and the population is African infants; no GSK filing names altSonflex (EDGAR full-text search, 0 hits, 2023 to 2026-11-16)

A Phase 2, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of subcutaneous LY3537021 on top of standard antiemetics in 204 adults receiving cisplatin or anthracycline-cyclophosphamide, primary outcome complete response in the delayed phase of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting, primary completion 2026-12 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07169851, read 2026-11-16). A GIPR monoagonist (ASCO 2026 abstract TPS855, doi:10.1200/JCO.2026.44.2_suppl.TPS855) and Lilly's own programme. Lilly files nothing on it: EDGAR full-text search for 'LY3537021' returns 0 hits, 2023-01-01 to 2026-11-16. No free source found in this search counts the US patients started on cisplatin or AC each year, no GIPR agonist is sold in any indication to give a price, and no Phase 3 or filing date exists to launch from, so pool, price and timing would all be invented

PF-07104091 (tegtociclib, Pfizer's CDK2 inhibitor; Rallybio 424B3 0001193125-26-422924, Iambic 424B4 0001193125-26-422865). NCT04553133 is a 'Phase 1/2a dose escalation, finding and expansion study', 157 enrolled, active not recruiting, primary outcomes dose-limiting toxicities, adverse events, vital signs and QTc, primary completion 2026-12-31; the catalyst is named after one of its arms, 'monotherapy dose expansion (SCLC)' (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04553133, read 2026-11-16). No Phase 3 is registered and Pfizer's filings never name the molecule (EDGAR full-text search, 0 Pfizer hits 2023 to 2026-11-16), so neither the indication it would launch in nor a year can be cited. Rallybio's October 2026 prospectus still describes it as in Phase 1 dose escalation; no discontinuation is stated, so it is not a discontinued_programmes row

The Phase 3 of Moderna's H5 pandemic influenza vaccine, 4,050 adults, HAI immunogenicity at Day 43, primary completion 2027-01-28 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07496450). data/assumptions/mrna_mrna_1018_h5.csv carries the probability legs and the company half and refuses on price: outside a pandemic an H5 vaccine is bought for government stockpiles by contract, and Moderna files no H5 supply or advance purchase agreement. Rechecked 2026-11-16: the Q3 2026 10-Q (0001682852-26-000197) does not mention mRNA-1018 or H5, and the 2026 8-Ks name only CEPI's up to $54.3mm of trial funding (0001682852-26-000007) and the Phase 3 start (0001682852-26-000057). A filed stockpile contract with doses and price would price it

GenTLE, uniQure's open-label Phase I/IIa of AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, primary endpoint safety at one year (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06063850). data/assumptions/qure_amt_260.csv carries pool, uptake, legs and company half and refuses on price on purpose: the 240,000 eligible US patients are two orders of magnitude beyond any one-time gene therapy price ICER lists, and no free source gives a price for this population. Rechecked 2026-11-16 in the Q3 2026 10-Q (0001104659-26-122367): no price, and 'In the third quarter of 2026, the Company completed enrollment in the second dose cohort of seven patients', so the one-year safety readout of the full study falls in 2027 and the registry's 2026-11-30 is likely to slip
